column2:
Business Model

  • CureMetrix: 11-year-old FDA-cleared AI diagnostic company

  • Detects heart disease in women from standard mammograms

    • First and only company with this capability

    • FDA clearance received Q4 2023

    • No extra radiation or discomfort required

  • Market opportunity: 40 million women get mammograms annually

    • Currently only 1-2% of radiologists report heart calcification findings

    • CureMetrix automates this to 100% detection rate

  • Pricing model: $20 per read to imaging centers

    • Centers charge patients $90-200 (Beverly Hills charges $200+)

    • High profit margins for imaging centers

Sales Strategy &
column3:
Challenges

  • Target market: 9,000 mammography sites in US

    • Avoiding hospitals (complex procurement, committees, long cycles)

    • Focused on 4,500 private equity-backed imaging centers

    • Examples: Solace Mammography, SimonMed, Radiology Partners

  • Current team structure:

    • Navid (CEO) actively selling

    • Kevin (President/COO)

    • One additional salesperson, looking to hire more

  • Lead generation methods:

    • Industry conferences (RSNA in Chicago)

    • Personal network and referrals

    • Third-party lead generation service (limited success)

  • Key barrier: No reimbursement code yet

    • Private centers charging out-of-pocket successfully

    • Hospitals reluctant without universal coverage

Chief Platform Fit Assessment

  • Current Chief platform likely too large for CureMetrix’s current size

    • Designed for sales teams of 3+ people

    • CureMetrix team stays connected daily, minimal risk of things falling through cracks

  • Future opportunities with Chief’s developing products:

    • SDR automation tool (in testing phase)

    • Sales copilot for meeting prep and note-taking

  • Potential design partnership opportunity once new features ready

Next Steps

  • Michele to send Chief marketing materials to Navid and Kevin for review

  • Michele will connect Navid with CEO Bret Larsen on LinkedIn

  • Future demo planned when SDR and sales copilot features are ready

  • Mutual network introductions offered

Chat with meeting transcript: https://notes.granola.ai/d/cb25153d-c350-4540-8bd4-c4cdc34eee41

column3:
Competitive Landscape

  • Lonny’s key concern: AI market oversaturation and buyer fatigue

  • Chief’s differentiators vs competitors like Clari:

    • ML platform vs single-purpose tools

    • Extensive integrations vs standalone solutions

    • Proactive insights vs purely reactive querying

  • Clay comparison: Chief uses Clay internally for SDR agent but focuses on broader data analysis vs list building

  • Lonny’s current Clari renewal situation:

    • Platform underutilized, poorly mapped, money wasted

    • Missing framework for strategic account designation

  • Lonny interested in design partnership but lacks bandwidth currently

    • Just hired analyst to provide support

  • Ali Andrew joined from her sister’s house in Michigan

  • Built In is currently in discovery phase for AI implementation in RevOps

    • No AI-related tools implemented yet on RevOps side

    • Increase efficiency

    • Reduce manual work

    • Provide more insights for sales team

    • Enable sellers to sell more effectively

    • Many manual processes (including deal reviews)

    • Lean team with limited bandwidth

    • Multiple dashboards and reports requiring hours of analysis

    • Using Salesforce and TurnZero currently

    • Planning to consolidate everything into Salesforce

    • Purchased TurnZero for Snowflake integration (for site data)

  • Chief platform has two key components:

    • Reactive side: Users interact with AI to ask questions about their data

    • Proactive side: AI raises alerts about important changes or issues

  • Current capabilities:

    • Sales agent functionality

    • Customer Success agent functionality

    • Dashboard visualization (in development, expected by end of year)

  • Integration process:

    • Connects with Salesforce/HubSpot, financial tools, call recording software

    • Machine learning platform pulls data (24-hour setup)

    • Maps to existing CRM structure including custom fields

    • Differences between Chief and their current ChatGPT/OpenAI implementation

    • HubSpot (CRM), Gong (call recording/forecasting)

    • Sales Loft (sequencing), Vitally (post-sales)

    • ReosDev (open source usage insights, social signals)

    • Rep.AI (website chatbot)

    • Yodeli (AI role-playing trainer) - just signed

  • Monday morning automated Google Sheets reporting (built by Bryan)

  • Transition plan: moving from Google Sheets to systematic reporting

  • Complex 20-call sales cycle from demo to close

  • Initial meeting → discovery (up to 4 calls) → qualification/demo (2 calls) → POC (daily calls) → negotiation

  • Current routing: demo requests go directly to AEs (no BDR qualification layer)

  • Significant prep time per opportunity: hours of research, value alignment docs, success criteria development

Product Demo Overview

  • Chief Platform overview presented by Bret to Dallen (CEO of Tava Health)

  • Platform features machine learning + generative AI layer for natural language interface

  • Context library builds at company, department and individual levels

  • Platform learns company-specific metrics, terminology and calculations

Key Use Cases &
column2:
Features

  • Two main platform interfaces:

    • Proactive predictive insights engine

    • Reactive “Company GPT” for data queries

  • Natural language data visualization capabilities

  • Automated task creation and tracking

  • Context-aware messaging templates

  • Secure document analysis features coming in Q2

  • User management and access controls in development

Tava Health’s Specific Needs

  • Primary focus on retention analytics across three customer types:

    • Providers/clinicians

    • Patients

    • Payers

  • Current challenges:

    • Single analyst extremely overworked

    • Complex cohort analysis needs

    • Provider availability tracking

    • Leading indicators of churn

  • Jake Source (VP of Engineering) and data engineering team identified as key stakeholders for next steps

  • Need to integrate with:

    • HubSpot

    • Google BigQuery

Commercial Discussion

  • Current pricing examples:

    • $90k/year for CS retention model (larger company)

    • $45k/year for sales model (smaller company)

    • $10k implementation fee

  • SOC2 Type 2 certified

  • Will require BAA agreement for HIPAA compliance

  • Company has runway through August 2026

Product Demo Overview

  • Demonstrated Chief’s predictive operations platform to George Sens (SVP Sales at Authvia) and Dave Haley (Director)

  • Platform integrates with Slack, Salesforce, and potentially Gmail (pending confirmation)

  • Takes 24-48 hours to connect and start machine learning process

  • Currently using prototype version as live environment contains internal data

Platform Core Features

  • Context Library

    • Combines qualitative and quantitative data

    • Pulls from CRM, financial tools, social media, website, competitor info

    • Can create team-specific contexts including partner-level segmentation

    • Includes North Star metrics with adjustable thresholds

    • Maintains audit trail for changes

  • Company GPT Integration

    • Uses OpenAI (but flexible with other AI platforms)

    • Can analyze sales performance data in minutes vs hours

    • Creates automated tasks based on insights

    • Generates visualizations and detailed analysis

    • Links to cloud storage (Google Drive) for document access

Proactive Insights System

  • Monitors metrics for 5% variations up/down

  • Sends notifications for concerning trends

  • Provides specific recommendations with supporting data

  • Example shared: 90-day decline in renewal rates (20% drop) and expansion revenue (15% drop)

  • Allows users to assign tasks, snooze, or archive insights

  • Interface designed similar to Google inbox to reduce notification fatigue

Commercial Terms

  • Base pricing: $45,000 ARR ($3,700/month)

  • Flexible pricing structure available

  • Unlimited users (discussed Authvia’s team size of ~45 employees)

  • Current integration questions pending confirmation:

    • Gmail integration capability

    • Google Calendar sync

    • Slack bi-directional communication

    • Google Drive integration details

Introductions

  • Jeff Barson is based in Salt Lake City

  • Former Chief Innovation Officer at HireVue (2011-2017)

  • Has 20+ years experience in technology startups

  • Current focus is on behavioral analysis and deep phenotyping

  • Connected through NBC program at University of Utah

Current Company Overview (Storyline)

  • Team of 12 core members plus research partnerships

  • Bootstrapped with no external funding

  • Revenue metrics:

    • DepoIQ subsidiary: $2M ARR in first 8 months

    • Projected $8M ARR by end of year

  • Technology capabilities:

    • Captures 420 facial tracking points

    • Extracts 30,000+ different data points

    • Generates ~1M times more data than typical EHR in 10 minutes

    • Analyzes pupil dilation, head movement, respiration, pronunciation

Use Cases &
column3:
Applications

  • Healthcare:

    • NICU assessments (1,000 videos from 400 babies)

    • Mental health monitoring

    • Cancer research

    • Psilocybin research

  • Legal Tech:

    • Analyzed 50,000 depositions last year

    • Projected 450,000 depositions this year

  • Criminal Justice:

    • Suicide risk assessment in prisons

    • Behavioral baseline scoring

  • Cost efficiency example:

    • Traditional neurological assessment: $2,300

    • Their solution: $5-7 per assessment

Technical Feedback on Chief’s Platform

  • Identified core technology stack:

    • Vector database

    • Large language model

    • Chat interface

  • Raised concerns about:

    • Potential market saturation

    • Need for differentiation

    • Pricing pressure from open-source alternatives

    • Risk of easy replication by competitors

Next Steps

  • Jeff will attend NBC alumni event tonight

  • Michele to coordinate follow-up meeting with CTO John Daniels

  • Jeff offered to help with:

    • Introductions

    • Strategic guidance

    • Market insights

  • Will connect on LinkedIn for ongoing communication

Context

  • Chase previously worked at Actify with Jon before its “implosion” in 2022

  • Currently runs an EdTech company focused on university graduation software

  • Company has been operating for 25+ years with strong retention

  • Projects $10M in revenue this year

  • Located in Newport Beach, CA

Current Business Challenges

  • Using Zoho CRM which has limitations:

    • Difficult to extract meaningful insights

    • Requires manual report creation and data joins

    • No dedicated RevOps person on team

    • Sales team “shooting blindly” without data-driven decisions

  • Has 2 full-time sales reps split between East/West coast

  • No SDR team or historical marketing spend

  • Looking for solution to better utilize CRM data across modules:

    • Accounts

    • Contacts

    • Leads

    • Ceremonies (custom graduation events module)

Chief’s Product Discussion

  • Jon demonstrated Chief’s platform capabilities:

    • Web interface similar to email inbox

    • Slack integration for notifications

    • Supports Zoho CRM integration

    • Can query across multiple data modules

    • Uses LLM technology for natural language queries

  • Current pricing: $45K annual contract

  • 4-6 week implementation timeline

  • Upcoming features include:

    • Lead scoring model

    • Identity service for data access control

    • Report automation

Next Steps

  • Chase to:

    • Evaluate other off-the-shelf solutions

    • Research alternatives during dedicated sprint

    • Send demo requests to other vendors

  • Jon will follow up in 1.5 months

  • Both agreed timing may not be right for immediate implementation but will stay in touch

column3:

  • Team to evaluate low-hanging fruit opportunities for automation

  • Continue SOC 2 certification process

  • Make offers to technical candidates

  • Explore potential referrals through Jeff’s network

  • Consider additional novel data sources to maintain competitive edge

Product Overview: Getchief Platform

  • Platform designed as a predictive operations platform with ML and AI layer

  • Initially focused on revenue/CS analytics, expanding to other departments

  • Core value: Reduces time to get business insights from weeks to minutes/seconds

  • 211 different platform integrations currently available

  • Key integrations: Salesforce, QuickBooks, Slack

  • Current pricing: $37.50/month per analyst (~$45k/year)

Key Product Features

ChiefChat

  • Contextual library leveraging company datasets

  • Scrapes website, competitor sites, social media, LinkedIn

  • Users can select preferred LLM (OpenAI, Grock, etc.)

  • Allows conversational interaction with business data

  • Includes permission-based hierarchy system

Insights Inbox

  • Proactive alert system for business anomalies

  • Structured like email inbox (similar to Google/Outlook)

  • Every insight includes:

    • Analysis of the situation

    • Recommended direction

    • Specific actionable steps

  • Actions: Assign tasks, snooze alerts, or archive insights

  • 24-hour data sync cycle with integrated platforms

Technical Infrastructure

  • Machine learning platform with contextual understanding

  • RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) model implementation

  • Guardrails for data access and external information

  • Integration with task management systems (Trello, HubSpot, Salesforce)

  • Nightly push/pull of data from connected sources

Partnership Discussion

  • Exploring partnership opportunities with Chief of Staff Roundtable

  • Potential areas of collaboration:

    • Community access

    • Speaking engagements about AI/ML

    • Product validation with Chiefs of Staff

  • Interest in monthly virtual meetups and future in-person events

  • Discussion of different partnership tiers and engagement levels

Next Steps

  • Nathan to send partnership model overview by end of week

  • Schedule follow-up meeting for next Tuesday/Wednesday

  • Connect Mandy with Roundtable community

  • Review pricing strategy and potential bundling options

  • Address website resource page (CEO’s YouTube content missing)

Meeting Details

  • Date: May 21, 2025, 09:28:36

  • Attendees: Michele Robinson (Getchief), Connor, Brett Larson (CEO, Chief), Mukhil (Head of Demand Gen, Zluri), Vinesh (Revenue Operations, Zluri)

  • Note: Letitia was invited but unable to attend

Product Overview

  • Chief is a machine learning platform using generative AI for business operations

  • Integrates with existing infrastructure (212+ integrations)

  • Creates company-specific data lake from various sources (Salesforce, QuickBooks, etc.)

  • Takes 24-48 hours for initial training on company dataset

  • Adapts to company-specific metrics and terminology (MRR vs ARR, etc.)

Key Differentiators vs Astra

  • Chief offers broader functionality beyond just Salesforce opportunities module

  • Provides deeper GTM data analysis across multiple platforms

  • Astra is more limited, focusing mainly on AE-specific features

  • Chief includes proactive insights and automated task creation

  • Chief can analyze meeting transcripts and create action items

Core Functionality

  • Ambient meeting analysis with action item creation

  • Pipeline analysis and deal monitoring

  • Customizable metrics library and data visualization

  • Proactive insights based on data patterns

  • Task creation and assignment capabilities

  • Role-based data access control (e.g., CFO vs support rep permissions)

Development Roadmap (Q2-Q3 2025)

  • Q2: Dataset download capability for technical users

  • Q3: Desktop application launch

  • Q3: CRM write-back functionality

  • Q3: Ambient listening device integration

  • Q3: Data visualization creation tools

  • Future: Native mobile app (Q1 2026)

Technical Gaps Identified

  • Currently lacks write-back capability to Salesforce

  • No integration with intent data platforms (Demandbase, Apollo)

  • Limited Slack integration for external communications

  • Mobile experience needs improvement

Next Steps

  • Michele, Connor, and Vinesh to sync up on internal discussion

  • Team to review current workflow and tech stack

  • Schedule follow-up demo with live product

  • Share recording with broader team

  • Evaluate translation of existing Zluri processes into Chief platform

Meeting Details

  • Date: May 21, 2025, 09:28:36

  • Attendees: Michele Robinson (Getchief), Connor, Brett Larson (CEO, Chief), Mukhil (Head of Demand Gen, Zluri), Vinesh (Revenue Operations, Zluri)

  • Note: Letitia was invited but unable to attend

Product Overview

  • Chief is a machine learning platform using generative AI for business operations

  • Integrates with existing infrastructure (212+ integrations)

  • Creates company-specific data lake from various sources (Salesforce, QuickBooks, etc.)

  • Takes 24-48 hours for initial training on company dataset

  • Adapts to company-specific metrics and terminology (MRR vs ARR, etc.)

Key Differentiators vs Astra

  • Chief offers broader functionality beyond just Salesforce opportunities module

  • Provides deeper GTM data analysis across multiple platforms

  • Astra is more limited, focusing mainly on AE-specific features

  • Chief includes proactive insights and automated task creation

  • Chief can analyze meeting transcripts and create action items

Core Functionality

  • Ambient meeting analysis with action item creation

  • Pipeline analysis and deal monitoring

  • Customizable metrics library and data visualization

  • Proactive insights based on data patterns

  • Task creation and assignment capabilities

  • Role-based data access control (e.g., CFO vs support rep permissions)

Development Roadmap (Q2-Q3 2025)

  • Q2: Dataset download capability for technical users

  • Q3: Desktop application launch

  • Q3: CRM write-back functionality

  • Q3: Ambient listening device integration

  • Q3: Data visualization creation tools

  • Future: Native mobile app (Q1 2026)

Technical Gaps Identified

  • Currently lacks write-back capability to Salesforce

  • No integration with intent data platforms (Demandbase, Apollo)

  • Limited Slack integration for external communications

  • Mobile experience needs improvement

Next Steps

  • Michele, Connor, and Vinesh to sync up on internal discussion

  • Team to review current workflow and tech stack

  • Schedule follow-up demo with live product

  • Share recording with broader team

  • Evaluate translation of existing Zluri processes into Chief platform

  • Team size: 22 total (7-8 full-time, 4-5 interns, 4-5 contractors)

  • Based in Phoenix, AZ with one remote engineer (Boston-based, departing)

  • Product offering:

    • Deal tracking functionality

    • Upcoming: Back office invoicing and accounting features (launching in 1-2 months)

Product Demo Overview

  • Demonstrated Chief’s platform functionality to Josh Cutler (CTO at Yardstik, Mentor at MESA)

  • Platform connects to ~212 data integrations currently

  • Key integrations shown: Salesforce and QuickBooks

  • Platform uses Slack authentication (Google/Microsoft integrations in development)

  • Data ingestion takes 24-48 hours for ML model training (Note: Josh flagged this as too long)

Core Platform Features

  • Onboarding Process:

    • Team selection and organization

    • Data source connections

    • Context library setup (goals, metrics, vision, values, ICP)

    • Customizable at company, department, or individual level

  • ChiefChat (Reactive Features):

    • Multiple LLM options available (OpenAI, DeepSeek, etc.)

    • Permission-based access aligned with source systems

    • Clarifying questions before providing answers

    • Task creation and assignment capabilities

  • Insight Inbox (Proactive Features):

    • Automated alerts for key business metrics

    • Four response options: Assign, Snooze, Archive, or Investigate

    • Available via web interface and Slack integration

    • Actionable recommendations included with insights

Key Feedback from Josh

  • Permission concerns: Need robust controls for sensitive data access

  • Data relevance: Historical data may not predict future solutions

  • UX Improvements needed:

    • Clearer feedback loops for machine learning

    • Better canonicalization of common queries

    • Shortcuts for frequently asked questions

    • Multi-player functionality for team-wide insights

Next Steps

  • Michele to email Josh for introduction to Mark (Head of Sales Operations)

  • Potential demo for sales operations team

  • Upcoming releases:

    • Sales analyst features

    • CS analyst features (expected in 2 weeks)

    • Development of CRM analysis capabilities

    • Focus on showing immediate value through Salesforce hygiene insights

Chat with meeting transcript: https://notes.granola.ai/d/5097d1bf-61a3-45e7-9aa9-f76cccf88f91

Product Overview and Positioning

  • Chief platform offers both reactive and proactive AI-powered functionality

  • Platform integrates with:

    • HubSpot (primary CRM integration)

    • Slack and Teams

    • Microsoft integration in development

    • Salesforce

  • Key differentiator: Contextualizes AI with business-specific data and documents

  • Currently focused on serving as revenue chief of staff

  • Working on task push/pull functionality with HubSpot

Key Features Demo

  • Reactive Features:

    • Web and Slack-based interface for direct queries

    • Quick analysis capabilities (e.g., quota attainment analysis in minutes vs. weeks)

    • Task creation and assignment functionality

    • Customizable notifications through Slack

    • Integration with calendar and meeting data

  • Proactive Features (Insight Inbox):

    • Automatically flags positive and negative trends

    • Provides three components for each insight:

      • Insight analysis

      • Strategic direction

      • Recommended action

    • Allows users to assign tasks, snooze alerts, or archive insights

    • Learning capability improves with more data input

column2:
Features

  • Core functionality: Contextualized AI chat interface for business data

  • Initial setup via Slack integration (preferred by most customers)

    • Select team members during onboarding

    • Assign teams for role-appropriate insights (marketing vs engineering)

  • 212 pre-built integrations available

    • Custom integrations possible (cost depends on platform/vertical)

    • Can connect to aggregation tools like Domo

  • Security permissions inherit from connected platforms

    • Maintains existing access hierarchies

    • Store manager example: sees own store + peer comparison data for motivation

Technical Capabilities

  • Machine learning requires 24-48 hours to optimize after data ingestion

  • Two operational modes:

    • Reactive: Chat interface for data queries (eliminates need for SQL/BI analysts)

    • Proactive: AI surfaces insights automatically (1-2 per week optimal)

  • Advanced features in development:

    • Call listening for prep/feedback

    • CRM task creation (with human approval)

    • Communication aggregation from multiple sources

  • LLM agnostic - customers choose preferred model (OpenAI, Claude, etc.)

column3:

  • Primary focus: Revenue/sales optimization

  • Example workflow: Sales manager queries rep performance → AI identifies “9 weekly meetings” as quota predictor → Creates actionable tasks for underperforming reps

  • Onboarding process: 4 stages including stage mapping and field mapping

  • Customizable for different management levels:

    • C-suite: Strategic insights with approval workflows

    • Mid-level: More directive task assignment

    • Frontline: Specific action items

column4:

    • BI tools lack conversational interface
